description: Direction tuning, two stimuli in RF, three attention conditions, all centered at 0 deg. Curve heights reorder: attend-variable is tallest (peak 1.0), ignored/fixation intermediate (peak ~0.72), attend-nonpreferred lowest (peak ~0.50). The paper's attention gain is modest: attend-variable/ignored peak ratio ~ 1.4 (and attend-variable/attend-nonpreferred ~ 2.0). KNOWN MODEL DIVERGENCE: the implementation's attend-variable/ignored peak ratio is ~3.3 — more than twice too strong.
